10.extractionRationale: Extracted all current retail prices from two German retailers: €4.90, €5.99, €3.79, €6.99, €8.99, and €9.99 (appearing twice). Calculated median as the average of the 3rd and 4th values when sorted: (€6.99 + €8.99) / 2 = €7.99

27.sourceTitle: BBB Cycling CoreCap AL Valve BTI-166 Tubeless Ventil
27.evidenceText: Five sources total: p1993550 and p1993549 are duplicate listings of the same BTI-166 valve product. Sources p1993585, p1993580, and p1993582 are valve cores (Ventilkern - accessories), not main valve products.
27.extractionRationale: Counted only distinct CoreCap valve products (not cores/accessories). The BTI-166 Al Valve appears as duplicate listings (p1993550 and p1993549), counting as 1 distinct product. The three BTI-165 Ventilkern items (valve cores in different colors) are accessories and excluded per instructions.

56.evidenceText: Five distinct Schwalbe inner tube models identified: No. 17 (28"), Nr. 13 (26"), Nr. 3 (16"), No. 19-EL (27.5/28/29"), Nr. 19 (27.5/28/29"). All explicitly list Clik Valve (SCV) in their specifications.

No. 19 and No. 19-EL are counted as separate models despite same tire size, as they represent distinct product variants (standard vs. Extra Light). Valves, conversion kits, and accessories were excluded.
